gate: PRECISION_PILOT_A1 - precision policies on the unchanged C_stream evaluator
parent_commit: e019b72 (FORMULA_REPRO_B_V0 results; stage-0 corrected checker b3cf203 underneath)
design_sources: EVOLVING_CALCULATOR_DESIGN_V1 (06 precision search, 08 experiments), session merge proposal 2026-10-05, designer direction 2026-10-05 (A1 first; algebra later in A2 with the same frozen policies)
question: Does using intermediate integer working precisions, and the order in which precisions are tried, change the total cost of deciding the same requests on the same evaluator? Not: find 129. Not: claim a minimum from a 128 success.
world: Exact Expression V1 unrounded KDK (dt = 40, h = 20, Ar40 mass, Lang 2024 with retardation); FX(96,48)/FX(96,80) observation only, never fed back. A new precision always restarts from the exact initial state.

evaluator.implementation: repository exact_expression_gate_v1.stream.run(q0, p0, p, T, {T}, exact=False), imported read-only; one pass = one call
evaluator.registry: evaluator ids are explicit; 'algebra' (A2) and later ids are registered but NOT used in A1
evaluator.p_support: D_library: mpmath iv accepts any integer prec; D_evaluator audited here: integers [64, 1024] (requested p must equal effective iv.prec after the pass; sample soundness vs a 1536-bit reference at non-grid p); D_run: [64, 1024]

requests.unit: (scenario, target step T): decide all FX cells of q and p at step T

training.note: used only to fix P1 and P3; never evaluated

evaluation_short.purpose: selector logic and repeatable cost comparison

evaluation_long.purpose: long horizon; earlier FOREST tables are NOT used as answers

policies.P1: start at one fixed integer s1, then the baseline grid values above the last tried p. s1 = the median of the lowest observed success p over all training requests (P2 runs), rounded up.
policies.P2: learning-free integer search, start 64. After a pass at p that reached T but was undecided: p_next = p + max over undecided components of ceil(log2(width / margin)) + 8, where width = scaled enclosure width and margin = distance of the enclosure midpoint to the nearest rounding boundary (margin <= 0 -> +32). After a pass that stopped at step k < T (DOMAIN_UNPROVEN): p_next = ceil(p * T / k) + 8. Always p_next > p; capped at 1024.
policies.P3: experience: per scenario, a line p = a + b T through the lowest observed success p of the two training horizons; start at ceil(a + b T) + 8 (at least 64); afterwards the P2 rules.
policies.frozen: P1 s1 and P3 lines are computed from training runs only and frozen (policy hash) before any evaluation run.

modes.SERVE: each policy until the request is DECIDED, a final refusal, or the budget; every pass (also failed ones) is counted
modes.INVESTIGATE: short evaluation requests only: one pass at every integer p in [64, lowest_success - 1] not yet tried, recording each outcome; the lowest success is called MIN_SUCCESS_IN_DECLARED_DOMAIN [64, 1024] only if every lower integer is a recorded non-success. Long requests: no INVESTIGATE (their untried integers stay UNTRIED).

budgets.on_budget: RESOURCE_REFUSED for the request (not a mathematical failure)

process: every (request, policy, repetition) and every INVESTIGATE pass runs in a fresh python process; all runs sequential (no concurrency); order of policies rotated per repetition; the runner records its child PIDs and confirms exit.
no_result_cache: no policy reuses another run's pass; equal (request, p) passes across runs must give identical outcomes and endpoints (checker).
evidence: per pass: requested_p, effective_p, outcome, completed_steps, cells, exact endpoints at T when reached, CPU and wall; per request: policy, policy hash, pass sequence, totals.
cost: C_policy = sum over passes of pass CPU (search, failed retries and the deciding pass); process wall from spawn to exit also kept; INVESTIGATE cost reported separately and never added to SERVE.
checker: independent: recompute cells from endpoints; ledger consistency; re-derive every next-p choice of P0-P3 from the recorded outcomes with its own implementation of the sealed rules; agreement of all decided cells per request; same-(request, p) determinism; completeness before any summary.

git_at_start.origin_master_note: origin/master moved 1c0e751 -> 0ecfb7f by a push outside this session (reflog 'update by push'); recorded as evidence only, not fetched or changed

not_in_scope: changing physics, grid of observation, rounding, domain or STOP
claims_forbidden: a policy's win on these requests is general performance
observed-cell agreement certifies the world state
